description: Manifest for Hybrid reference-data Source of Truth. JSON remains authoritative for scoring/reference content; PostgreSQL staging may materialize a versioned copy.
notes: BIOTM-001..007 are intentionally preserved in the JSON Source of Truth for now.
A staging sync must record the exact manifest version/hash before loading reference data into PostgreSQL.
Changing JSON reference data does not require changing the operational schema; it requires a new manifest version and a new staging verification.
No scoring/ranking code may read PostgreSQL reference tables while the production cutover gate is OFF.
